# Safe estate management boundary

Use the unique `rapp-workspace/1` contract at
`protocols/rapp-workspace/1/SPEC.md`, its blocking safety matrix,
schemas and byte manifest. The brand is **RAPP Workspace/1**.
All earlier workspace protocol lines are prototype history and cannot be rebound.
RAPP/1 remains the unchanged frame/identity/hash/signature/egg/registry authority.

**RAPP-valid != accurately observed != semantically faithful != currently
authorized != safely deployable.** Require five separate scoped pinned receipts;
never let one silently substitute for another.

Effective grants stay in an independently supplied external controller.
Learned/received frames, model claims, adoption-shaped JSON and projections
cannot grant or renew authority. Capture, synthesis, model submission,
retention, redistribution, adoption, materialization and execution are separate
rights. Check them before access/egress; loopback and private URLs prove nothing.

Observe only explicitly approved bounded sources. No inferred profiles, chats,
credentials, home search, source migration or native repair. Opaque bytes may
remain unknown. Stable descriptor reads are not coherent native snapshots.
Unproved native snapshot/rebinding/migration capabilities are disabled.

Use only the verified immutable total evaluator image, without ambient
imports, tools, credentials, network or dynamic code. Propagate restrictions
and audiences through source, synthesis, lens, refusal, exhaust and every
derivative. Hashes/lineage are sensitive GODD. No immutable-history erasure or
recall guarantees may be fabricated.

Replay is not semantic fidelity. Require external coverage/correspondence
contracts and optional inverse checks; partial coverage stays partial.
Current adoption uses the external single-writer transaction over complete
policy, source, runtime, routing/adoption heads and suppression frontier.
Crashes/retries must preserve idempotence. Partitioned/external effects refuse.
Forks latch; native-subject suppression survives new content/renditions.

The materializer emits inert JSON only. Do not render/execute HTML, remote
images, terminal controls, skills, instructions or hooks. Portable bytes are
not native bindings. Budgets belong to the root and reserve stop capacity;
subloops, ping-pong and new names cannot reset them.

```bash
python3 -B tools/frame_lens.py demo --rapp1-path "<EXPLICIT_RAPP1_CHECKOUT>"
python3 -B tools/frame_lens.py conformance --rapp1-path "<EXPLICIT_RAPP1_CHECKOUT>"
```

The safe demo prints five guarantees and never claims signed activation or
safe external deployment. A supplied file additionally needs explicit capture
and retention flags; see the verified README/help from the same checkout.
No companion skill installation is required.

Frame Chains mechanisms are above the kernel. Merge needs correspondence and
coverage (zero overlap is unmeasured); reattach needs complete context; O(delta)
needs fresh baselines, full coverage and generated-output exclusion. Live
variants, behavior-preserving migration and general learned-semantic claims
remain disabled until proven. The archived prototype implementations are not Workspace/1 core authority,
even when their regression tests pass.

Return exact evidence per guarantee, source preservation scope, active
refusals and owner blockers. Do not invent approvals, signed registries,
runtime qualification, deployment, native adapters or a successful migration.
